verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded documents processing regular payrolls: scheduled payrolls are pre-generated, unprocessed upcoming payrolls can be retrieved, and a 'complete a regular payroll' guide exists. That establishes a payroll-run capability, but the pack never shows a single flow that reviews hours and earnings, previews totals, and submits; the only documented preview is for contractor payments, and the CLI explicitly cannot submit payroll. missing for 10: documented regular-payroll review of hours/earnings, payroll totals preview step, submit step shown within one end-to-end flow, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run a full payroll cycle end-to-end — review hours and earnings, preview totals, and submit — in one flow

citations.quote: Upcoming regular payrolls can be retrieved by calling GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/payrolls with processing_statuses=unprocessed.
We automatically pre-generate scheduled regular payrolls based on the company’s pay schedule and corresponding pay periods.
Handle all aspects of payroll management including regular payroll runs, off-cycle payments, termination processing
